_readme: talentsforever.com data export for the Warrior. Fan-made WoW Forever talent calculator; talents, racials, Legacy perks and the class spellbooks come from the WoW Forever beta client's own data files (the site began as frame-by-frame reads of the BlizzCon 2026 demo), so numbers can lag live tuning. talents: per class, trees with talents (row/col are 1-based grid positions, max is the rank cap, desc maps rank number to tooltip text, confirmed lists ranks read verbatim, others are estimates; classic shows the Classic-era equivalent for comparison). spellbooks: per class, every trainer spell to level 60 with every rank (levels = the level each rank is learned at; checked = that class's city trainer was read in game, the rest are from the files only; the General tab dates from the demo reads). spell_desc: tooltip text keyed class|spell|rank, s=beta means the beta client's text at level 60 with no gear, s=demo means read off footage, s=classic means Wowhead Classic fallback, nt=1 or 2 means the class trainer does not sell that rank (1 portal trainer, 2 tome, quest or drop). racials and legacy: racial abilities and the Legacy perk trees. changelog: what changed on the site. class_abilities: Baseline, in the Arms tab. Instant, 30 sec cooldown: a melee hit that heals you for 10% of your maximum health, usable within 20 sec of killing something non-trivial. Read off Soda's stream via a reader.

A passive in the Arms tab now, not a talent. You keep up to 10 Rage when you change stances on your own, and the Arms talent Improved Tactical Mastery adds up to 15 more. Read off Soda's Warrior video via a reader.
Still in the game: the Fury tree has Improved Intercept. It just isn't in the level 38 spellbook, so it's probably learned later than 30 now.
Rank 3 by 38 (Classic reached that at 46) and it has an 18 sec cooldown now.
Changed. Works in Battle or Defensive Stance. Rank 4 slows attacks 20% for 22 sec and hits up to 4 targets, where Classic was 10% for 30. Read off Xaryu's stream, thanks to a reader.
Still there, in the Protection tab. 116 health for 10 rage plus 10 more over 10 sec.

Changed: 15 min cooldown, 60% less damage for 12 sec (Classic was 30 min, 75% for 10 sec). In Esfand's video it was ready while Retaliation was on cooldown, so the shared cooldown with Retaliation and Recklessness looks gone. Two readers flagged this.
Changed: 2 charges and 7 sec baseline (Classic was 1 block for 5 sec). Still 10 Rage, 5 sec cooldown, Defensive Stance. Read from a Tyler1 spellbook screenshot a reader sent in.
